translations.text: Now I will teach you as one should teach someone dear.

If you wish to rise to the flourishing kingdom, then be humble and eager to give alms, wise in your words, and love vigils with a holy mind during this passing time, with a joyful heart, and keep at your prayers, as often as you can, wherever you are alone.
For holy prayer, and pure love of God and of people, and almsgiving, and great hope in your Saviour
that he will wipe out your sins, together with many other good works, adorn the righteous soul and bring it to rest in the heavenly blessedness.
Whatever you do, in word or deed, always keep the fear of the Lord in it; that is truly the beginning of wisdom, so that you do not lose the eternal light altogether.
This world is at its end, and we are still paupers in respect of the kingdom of heaven; that is a heavy burden.

And even if, after your death, you give away everything good that you had earlier gained on earth, wishing to please God, you cannot with all of it set your soul free if it is held captive inside by fiends, deprived of comfort and denied all riches;

But pray earnestly to the God of glory, the eternal Almighty, that he not abandon you into the hands of the hateful, as a comfort to fiends; rather flee from there. Give alms often and frequently, in secret; that is the offering to the Lord of every man who believes in God.
Buy eternal light for yourself with your possessions, so that you do not perish when you no longer have power over them to give them away.
It is very bad for any man to own much if he does not fear God far more than his own will.
Guard yourself carefully against filling your belly, because it gathers all the vices that harm the soul most: drunkenness and secret fornication, and immoderate desire for food and sleep.

These one may drive away with fasting and abstinence. And by going to church in cold weather, humbly and wholeheartedly pray to the Lord of heaven, the gentle protector, that he give you salvation as seems fitting to him.

And fear the secret ways, the narrow thoughts that come by night, and sinful lusts that very often [?] work great hardship. Therefore, grey-haired warrior, you must fearfully and deeply lament your sins;
your sins will seem heavy to you. For you yourself understand that you must leave behind your transitory dwelling places, your home and native land.
Then you will not know what your Lord intends to do with you, when you may no longer enjoy life and dwell in your homeland as you did before, exultant in joys.
Now you must protect yourself and hold your soul firmly against every enemy; they are always striving for it, day and night, against the life of the Lord.

You can put them to flight if you are willing to follow my teachings, as I teach you privately: that at dawn you often think deeply about what is good for your soul, how you may ever gain the eternal light and seek it out on your journey.
You must gladly labor hard for the heavenly homeland, day and night; you must flee drunkenness and give up all gluttony.
If you want to choose the heavenly dwelling, then you must think about it beforehand, here on earth, and bind yourself firmly, and give up all the vices that you loved and fed before in this life.
